You can also share the script file to Foundry from your Files or browser app.
Status and Shift show your real next event and countdown.
Status and Solar show the weather and daylight where you are.
Put a widget on your home screen

1. Touch and hold an empty spot on your home screen.
2. Tap Widgets, find Foundry and drag it onto the screen.
3. Pick your theme, the widget you want and its size, then tap Add widget.
4. To change it later, touch and hold the widget and choose its settings (or remove it and add it again).

Widgets redraw about every 15 minutes, when you plug in or unplug the charger, and when you open this app.
Foundry runs the same widget scripts as iPhone. Your calendar and location stay on your phone; only your approximate position is sent to the free weather service, Open-Meteo.

Foundry reads your calendar so the Status widget can show your next event and the Shift widget can count down to the event you choose. It only reads; it never changes your calendar, and nothing leaves your phone.\n\nAndroid will ask you next.

Foundry uses your approximate location (about a town’s width) to get local weather, sunrise and sunset for the Status and Solar widgets. It is only sent to the free weather service Open-Meteo, and Foundry only asks while the app is open.\n\nAndroid will ask you next.
